{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Fix revenue: convert string with commas to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm conversion
print("Revenue dtype after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample converted revenue:", sales_df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())

# Check if any customer_segment is missing or invalid
print("Customer segment value counts:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for any other issues
print("Any nulls in converted?", sales_df['converted'].isnull().sum())
print("Any nulls in status?", sales_df['status'].isnull().sum())"}
